ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark grey to black) base with approximately 25-35% high-intensity (white/light grey) mottling and scarring concentrated toward the lateral margins and central-right lobe.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white mottling forming irregular geometric clusters on the distal regions of both lobes. Right lobe shows larger contiguous light-pixel zones. Numerous high-intensity circular micro-blobs (diameter <10 pixels) are scattered across the medial dark regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an estimated internal vertex angle of 45 degrees, exhibiting deep vertical penetration relative to the lobe horizontal axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile; trailing edge consists of sharp pixel-amplitude peaks and jagged valleys across the entire visible span, isolated clearly against the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-lateral concave curvature originating from the median notch, sweeping upward and outward toward the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular white ring clusters and solid light-colored spots (barnacle attachment sites) distributed non-uniformly, with high visibility against the dark pigment in the central-left and central-right sectors.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible calcified epibiont colonization (barnacles) localized at the extreme lateral tips; significant irregular erosion and non-uniform jaggedness along the trailing edge indicative of cumulative tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Dense, high-contrast crustose-like clusters at the outermost terminal edges of both lobes.
